title: Pip's Garden Walk
objectives_ko: 글자 A~L 12개의 이름과 소리를 빠르게 말한다
A~L로 시작하는 단어 36개를 듣고 그림을 고른다
사이트워드 I, see, a, the, is, it, my, and, in을 보고 읽는다

panels.desc: A bright morning on the winding path of the first Sound Garden. Bun, Hedgie and Pip stroll past the first letter trees in a row: an apple tree, a tree with bus-, bag- and bed-shaped fruits, a tree with cat-, cup- and candy-shaped fruits, and a tree with dog-, duck- and doll-shaped fruits. Pip stands under the apple tree about to say a sound, but its beak is scrunched up for a huge sneeze, feathers puffed. Bun counts the trees on her paw; Hedgie carries a small red backpack. Hidden in the picture: a red apple on the ground, a toy bus on the path, an orange cat under a tree, a brown puppy. Grumble does NOT appear.

Further along the path: the trees with egg-, elf- and exit-sign fruits, with fan-, frog- and fork fruits, with goat-, gift- and guitar fruits, and with hen-, hippo- and hammer fruits — and every one of them is wearing a big striped nightcap pulled down over its leafy crown like a sleeping cap! Grumble stands on a wobbly wooden ladder against the hen tree, tying the last striped nightcap onto it, frowning with his tongue out in concentration; his lantern hangs on the ladder glowing softly. Bun and Hedgie stare up at the hatted trees with open mouths; Pip hovers beside a hat, puzzled. Hidden in the picture: a white egg in the grass, a green frog on a stone, the white goat peeking from behind a tree, the brown hen under the ladder.

lines.text: A hat is on the tree!

panels.desc: POP! POP! POP! The striped nightcaps have all popped off the trees at the sound of the letters and are floating down like leaves; the trees with ink-, igloo- and insect fruits, jelly-, juice- and jump fruits, key-, kite- and koala fruits, and lemon-, leg- and lock fruits stand bare and cheerful again. Grumble sits on the ground in a pile of fallen nightcaps with one over his eyes, his ladder tipped over, his lantern beside him glowing a little brighter. Hedgie opens his red backpack and shows the golden key inside; Bun jumps and claps; Pip glows. Hidden in the picture: an ink bottle on a stump, a jar of red jelly on a bench, a red kite in a tree, a yellow lemon on the path.

lines.text: The key is in my bag.

panels.desc: Grumble's burrow at the foot of the hill. Grumble sits in the mouth of his dirt hole wearing all his striped nightcaps stacked in a tall wobbly tower on his head, chin on his paws, looking at the twelve letter trees with a wistful, envious face; his candle lantern beside him glows with a soft steady light. Pip has hopped right up to the burrow and waves a wing at him; Bun and Hedgie wave from the path. Twelve letter trees fill the background like a little orchard.

videos.prompt: Gentle comic picture-book animation: the baby bird under the apple tree scrunches up, then sneezes with a tiny puff and a few apple leaves flutter down; the rabbit and the hedgehog giggle; the letter trees sway in the breeze. Camera still. Soft, child-friendly. No text.

Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.
